items.title: Edward "Noon" Johnson Interview, 1960-05-28
items.q: The interviewee does not respond to the interviewer's mention of Sam Rankin playing in the group, nor does the interviewee mention Sam Rankin in their own speech.

ctx.x: Or was that the Absinthe House or Brennan's? Did they own the same places? Oh they both here own the same place but it was at the Palliot-Roll, that's his place too. Yeah that's right. That's right. That's right. What group did you have then when you made the movie?
Slow-drag I heard was playing bass, Harrison Dureck playing tenor-dang-jo, Sam Rankin playing
